description: Get cloud activity tracer logs with filtering by period, service, and user. Uses POST method with JSON body. Time parameters accept ISO 8601 strings and are converted to epoch milliseconds internally.

endTime.description: End time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2024-01-31T23:59:59Z"). Converted to epoch ms internally. (Required)

nrn.description: Ncloud Resource Name to filter specific resource activities

startTime.description: Start time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"). Converted to epoch ms internally. (Required)

name: ncloud_get_activity_logs
